label: Time & weather
on_description: time and weather are set client-side
description: Fixes the time of day and clears the rain, on your screen only.
settings_description: Settings for the Time & weather gameplay mod. Client-side only: the server's clock and weather are unchanged, mobs still burn when the server says it is day, and nobody else sees a difference. It changes the sky, the light and the rain you see.

lock_time.description: Whether the time of day is held at `time_ticks` instead of following the server.

time_ticks.description: Time of day to hold, in ticks: 0 is sunrise, 6000 noon, 12000 sunset, 18000 midnight.

clear_weather.description: Whether rain, snow and thunder are hidden. The rain also stops darkening the sky.
